interpretation: The r1 comparison isolates the registered objective change while label identity and other registered training settings stay equal.
FM longitudinal and braking reweighting changes optimizer scaling and task balance; road compliance regresses despite average collision/TTC improvement.
Endpoint derivative fitting is applied to random-time linear-bridge FM estimates; it is not a loss on the native final 10-step rollout.
All four full runs apply the FM objective from update1. The rollout warmup does not ramp the FM endpoint/reweighting terms.
The selected objective was screened by 512 updates from mature S3@100k and S0@50k checkpoints; that evidence does not establish from-scratch superiority.
V12 changes label coverage and targets, and its additional aggregate 50k regression relative to r1 has a confidence interval crossing zero.
Which individual objective component causes the road/heading tradeoff still requires matched ablations; no causal ranking of its three components is established.
ongoing_full_runs: Keep their registered definitions; report subsequent fixed milestones without retuning on Navtest.
